mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hwei primes enemy champions he damages with his abilities for his signature finishing touch.

Hitting an enemy with a second damaging spell completes his signature, leaving it beneath them. The signature detonates after a short delay, dealing magic damage to all enemies in range.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Hwei's damaging Abilities against enemy champions mark them for @Duration@ seconds.

Hitting marked enemies with a second damaging Ability creates an explosion underneath them dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to all enemies in range.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_HweiPassive_Tooltip}}

Each Ability can only trigger this effect once per target.
Slows from Hwei's abilities stack with each other at a diminishing rate (but not items or other sources)

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has been marked by one of Hwei's damaging abilities. If Hwei damages them with a second ability it will detonate the mark, leaving his signature on the ground that explodes after a delay.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies.

{{Spell_HweiEQ_Name}}
Hwei launches a terrifying face that causes the first enemy hit to Flee for @Tooltip_EQFleeDuration@ second(s) and take @Tooltip_EQDamage@ magic damage.

{{Spell_HweiEW_Name}}
Hwei forms an eye that lingers and provides vision locking onto the first enemy champion that enters and launching a homing missile that Roots the first enemy hit for @Tooltip_EWRootDuration@ seconds dealing @Tooltip_EWDamage@ magic damage.

{{Spell_HweiEE_Name}}
Hwei paints a set of jaws at a target location that Drags enemies to the center dealing @Tooltip_EEDamage@ magic damage and Slowing enemies caught by @Tooltip_EESlowAmount@% decaying over 1.25 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.

Hwei paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies.

{{Spell_HweiQQ_Name}}
Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @Tooltip_QQDamage@ plus @Tooltip_QQBonusDamage@% max health magic damage.

{{Spell_HweiQW_Name}}
Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing @Tooltip_QWDamage@ magic damage. Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to @Tooltip_QWBonusDamage@ magic damage, based on the target's missing health.

{{Spell_HweiQE_Name}}
Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing @Tooltip_QEDamage@ magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by @spell.HweiQE:SlowPercent@% and deal @Tooltip_QEDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second for @spell.HweiQE:Duration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for @Duration@ seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for @SlowPercentPerStack@% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing @DamageOverTime@ magic damage per second.

Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing @Damage@ magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hwei clears his paintbrush and returns to base abilities without using mana or cooldowns. Only available while {{Spell_HweiQ_Name}}, {{Spell_HweiW_Name}}, or {{Spell_HweiE_Name}} are active.
